title: fix(ci): quote workflow step name YAML truncates at " #", add guard
body:
Fixes #15149

## What

Two halves, both in scope per PM ruling (issue comment, `baozhoutao`, 2026-09-10):

**Half 1** — `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: quoted the one step name that is an
unquoted plain scalar containing ` #` (space + hash), which YAML reads as
starting a comment. Before this fix the step's real parsed name was the
three-letter string `The`, not the text an author wrote.

```diff
-      - name: The #13419 name-fold fixture has no non-test loader
+      - name: 'The #13419 name-fold fixture has no non-test loader'
```

**Half 2** — a new grep-level guard, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`
(`scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs`), wired as the last step of
the `lint` job (append-only, per the job's prose-only step-ordering contract,
#10572) and as a `check:*` script in `package.json`. It uses the criterion
triage wrote (issue comment, R+152, and restated in the dispatch comment):
look only at the first non-blank character after `- name:`; `'`/`"` means
already quoted (skip); otherwise search the remaining text for ` #`.

## Delivery order is the proof

The guard reads `.github/workflows/*.yml`. Run against the pre-fix tree
(`origin/main` `cca1dc0bfb`, via `git archive`, no working-tree mutation) it
is **RED**, naming exactly the offending line; run against the post-fix tree
it is **GREEN**.

**RED, before Half 1** (scanned via `scan()` over a temp copy of `origin/main`'s
`.github/workflows/`):

```
check-workflow-step-name-quoting: 1 unquoted step name contain ` #`, which YAML reads as a comment -- the parsed step name is NOT the text you see

  • .github/workflows/lint.yml:746
      - name: The #13419 name-fold fixture has no non-test loader

scanned 35 workflow file(s), 667 step name(s) total (positive control)
```

**GREEN, after Half 1** (`node scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs`,
run for real against this branch):

```
check-workflow-step-name-quoting: OK (scanned 35 workflow file(s), 668 step name(s) -- 8 already quoted, 660 unquoted-and-safe).
```

(667 → 668 step names because the guard's own new step name is counted too;
668 total lines up with the repo-wide hit count the PM measured — exactly 1
violation before, 0 after, and it is the line being fixed here.)

## Negative control

`check-links.yml:187` is a real, **legal**, unquoted step name containing an
embedded `"` — triage self-inflicted a false positive on exactly this shape by
naively stripping quote characters before judging. The guard's `--list` output
against this branch confirms it is **not** flagged:

```
ok        .github/workflows/check-links.yml:187  - name: Report a setup failure as "the link check did not run"
```

## Repo-wide hit count + positive control

| | files | step names scanned | violations |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| before (origin/main `cca1dc0bfb`) | 35 | 667 | **1** (`lint.yml:746`) |
| after (this branch) | 35 | 668 | **0** |

667/668 step names scanned (non-zero) is the positive control that the probe
reads something — a scanner that stopped matching would report 0 either way.

## `--self-test` against the raised floor

Mandatory per the dispatch comment, plus the floor-raising cases (#13799):
flags this card's shape; does not flag an already-quoted `'… #123 …'`; does
not flag the check-links.yml unquoted-name-with-embedded-`"` negative control;
does not flag a normal trailing YAML comment on a **non**-`- name:` line
(the boundary a naive "line contains ` #`" scan would get wrong).

```
✓ check-workflow-step-name-quoting --self-test: 18 assertions across 6 batteries (real scan() path, temp fixture roots).
```

## Changeset

`skip-changeset` — measured, not asserted. All three changed paths are
structurally outside anything a published package ships:

- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — CI workflow, never published.
- `package.json` (repo root) — `"private": true`.
- `scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs` — repo-root `scripts/`, not
  inside any package directory.

Checked every workspace package's `package.json` `files[]` array for any entry
referencing `../`, `scripts`, or `.github` — zero hits across all publishable
packages (`packages/cli`, `packages/client`, `packages/client-react`,
`packages/cloud-connection`, `packages/console`, …), confirming no publishable
`files[]` can reach outside its own package directory to any of the three
changed paths.

## Gates run

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
derived 62 commands for this diff (33 `pnpm`, 29 direct `node`). All 62 ran
green — see the structured report for the full list and per-command exit
codes.

**Clause-②**: no

## 验收备注

- The step immediately before this PR's new step ("Duration-shaped spec keys
  carry their unit in the key name") carries a comment claiming it is
  "Placed LAST in this job on purpose... nothing behind it would be masked by
  its red." This PR appends after it (per the job's append-only step-ordering
  contract, #10572), which makes that comment stale by one step. Not filed —
  doc nit, no reproducible defect, no contract violated (the ordering contract
  is about relative order of *existing* steps, not about which step is
  textually last). 承接者:无 — noted here for whoever next appends to this job.
